about: 🗼 Watchtower: what comes in from outside — the sources with what is new in each, the feed, a signal read in full, and what to listen for.

sources.about: a chip per source with what is new in it (it filters the feed), when it last looked; Open new, Read all, Check now, Sources & intent; a failing one says why

feed.about: the chosen source's signals (or all of them), one line each, new ones marked; a signal opens here, over the feed, to be read in full, and so do the sources and the intent

item.about: kept for older documents: a signal now opens over the feed, in the feed pane
